method: Agent visually inspected actual Blender renders, Unity captures and sampled animation frames; geometric checks are reported separately.

observations.finding: Both socket types show empty/Energy/Cargo. Large central target/plug symbols distinguish empty sockets; repeated perimeter type marks, identity strips and separate power lamps remain outside occupied crate footprints. Only Energy lights the lamps.

Blue square, purple triangle and lime circle are visible. The same blue source appears on multiple gates; Any opens with A only, All remains closed with Cargo on B. A third independent badge is present.
Two shutter sections rise on separate tracks. Sampled cargo-held, robot-held and empty/closed frames match the continuous staged sequence; identity colors remain while power lamps stay off.

Upper gate and wall renderers disappear while full-cell wall plinths, corner feet and passage markers remain. Mixed 3x3 floors, rotated L/straight/end and T/cross wall assemblies meet at the common pitch with no outward protrusions.

Energy windows and radial top emblem contrast with enclosed cargo panels and X braces, including grayscale and four-sided perspective observation. The current robot reads at the same scale. No bloom or texture dependency is needed for identification.

limits: Unity scenes use explicit presentation states, not formal RuleEngine event binding.
Small source badges are intended for elevated/top-down views and may need short UI labels at full-board zoom.
No game-wide regression or performance benchmark is claimed.
